name: Ses Bruixes
description: A sea captain's house from 1811 in central Maó, restored by its architect owner across two buildings with fifteen rooms. Its Menorcan garden — where the Es Jardí restaurant serves — is one of the city's best-loved corners, and the Illa Spa completes the house. Elegance with memory: the original elements lead.
